items.title: Unramified second reciprocity law for Gross-Kudla-Schoen diagonal cycles on triple Shimura curves
items.author: Haining Wang
items.difficulty_reason: The explicit diagonal-class/local-period identity requires simultaneous arithmetic level raising and refined new/old integral structure, the weight/monodromy spectral sequence on the semistable triple product with Iwahori level, and a geometric calculation of diagonal specialization/pairings. Complete original residual/minimal/large-image, clean auxiliary and admissible-prime conditions retained, as is the authors proper-Shimura Nminus!=1 scope. Old new-old-part is one support proposition, not the full second reciprocity law. The original rank3 weak-bipartite versus symmetric-cube distinction is retained without upgrading the triple construction to a strict rank1 system.

primary.label: Complete original unramified second reciprocity law

proof_spans.label: Complete weight spectral sequence, refined arithmetic level raising, triple-product monodromy/diagonal-specialization and second-reciprocity proofs

contexts.label: Original proper-Shimura, triple-form/residual/clean/admissibility and diagonal-class/local-pairing setup
